device.description: 18-bit bridge-sensor delta-sigma ADC, gain 64, 10/80 SPS, 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK)
device.note: ads1130.pdf (SBAS458A) p.3 electrical characteristics, p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, p.7 data rate, data format and DRDY/DOUT, p.8 data retrieval timing (tPD 50 ns, tCONV 12.5/100 ms), p.9 standby, p.10 power-down

pages: p.3 (EC: data rate, logic levels, supply 2.7-5.3 V), p.4 (pins), p.7 (data rate Table 1, data format Table 2, DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), p.8 (data retrieval Figure 6, tPD, tCONV), p.9 (standby), p.10 (power-up, power-down)
notModeled: 2-wire interface (no CS): modeled as SPI without CS per schema; a read is the 18 SCLKs after DRDY/DOUT falls; the result is the 0 V code
SCLKs after the 18 data bits force DRDY/DOUT high (modeled idle 1); without them the pin holds the last bit until tUPDATE before the next data (modeled: ready only clears on a read)
tUPDATE (no readback while data update) and the DRDY/DOUT high period during the update when the data were not read
standby mode (SCLK held high > tDSS after DRDY/DOUT falls) and wake-up (tS_RDY); single conversions by standby
PDWN low also resets the ADC and the power-up wake-up time (modeled as power-down only; no registers)
conversion time is tCONV = 1 / data rate from the SPEED pin (12.5 ms / 100 ms); digital-filter settling (4 conversions) not modeled; internal oscillator only
Do not apply more than 24 SCLKs during data retrieval (not enforced)
